name: Sorted: Left to spend
subtitle: Bills, plans, a clearer view
promotionalText: See what is left until payday, spot spending changes and keep upcoming payments current. Ask Penny for a chart or a plan, then review the details before confirming.
shortDescription: See estimated left to spend, upcoming bills and plans in one calmer money view.
description:
A clearer view of your money until payday.

Sorted brings your money into a calmer view, with figures you can inspect and choices that stay yours.

SEE WHAT IS LEFT UNTIL PAYDAY
See an estimated left to spend after upcoming bills, plans and your buffer. Open the calculation to understand the working. Estimates depend on the bank data and information available, and can miss unconnected accounts, late payments or bills Sorted has not spotted.

CHECK WHAT IS COMING
View expected payments and an account-by-account forecast. Add a one-off payment, then update its amount or date as plans change. Payments can take a day or two to appear.

REVIEW YOUR NEXT STEP
Review cover suggestions that can draw from more than one account. See each suggested contribution before making transfers in your bank. Set money aside each pay period or build a goal across planned payday contributions. Sorted does not make the bank transfer.

SEE WHERE SPENDING CHANGED
Track expenses and compare categories with your usual spending at the same point in your pay period. Open the payments behind a change. Money moved between your accounts stays separate from spending. Review your month and compare your actual split with an adapted 50/30/20 reference.

KEEP INVESTMENTS IN VIEW
Track recorded investment balances alongside your wider money picture. Capital at risk. Tracking is not investment advice.

ASK PENNY
Ask Penny to chart spending, propose a goal or update a planned payment. Review the amount, dates and source before confirming a supported change. Ongoing permissions have a separate consent step. General information, not regulated financial advice.

CONNECT YOUR BANKS
Choose your bank, review the connection information and continue to Finexer. Open banking is provided by Finexer Ltd, with AURIQ LTD acting as its agent. Availability depends on your bank and account.

Example images use fictional data. Forecasts and suggestions are estimates, not guarantees.
